text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's have a snowball fight, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. To tell you the truth, I'm trying to
try lots
of new things recently!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The other day, a friend taught me
knitting! Oh,
and yesterday, I made
omelet rice!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Even though my knitting turned out
all
tangled and I burnt my omelet, it was
super-duper
fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So I wanna try a snowball fight next! My
friend
from the shopping district invited
me to play! It'll
be two-on-two, with
prizes at stake!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her this eager to challenge
herself, I can't
find it within me to refuse
her.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's win it too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's completely snowed over! Isn't it
pretty?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll be fine! I'll get nice and warm soon
enough!
Plus, it's easier to move arou—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, everyone's already here! Hi, guys! I
brought
my trainer along!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara's eyes meet those of the
other
participants. Behind their friendly
smiles lies an
air of fierce competitive
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Participant
text_block_list.text:
Urara, we won't lose to you today! Bring
it on!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Okay! We aren't losing either! Right,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple! Get hit with
snowballs three
times and you're out!

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Utilize the snow trenches available and
topple
the plastic flag in your
opponent's field with a
snowball!
Understood?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
A strategy?! Wow! You sound just like a

commander!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I gotta think too! Hmm... Hnnngh...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I think we should make a lotta snowballs!
Should
we make and throw them
together?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Or should we do those separately? What
do you
think, Commander?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I consider all the ideas she throws my
way and put
together a strategy. Soon
after, the snowball
fight begins.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I think we've made enough snowballs.
What about
the other team?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The team in question launches snowballs
in our
direction at periodic intervals, as
if wary of our
advance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the openings make it possible to
avoid their
projectiles while invading
deep into their
territory.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Roger! I'll break their ranks, so you
protect the
flag, Commander! And...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Cover me please!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Don't worry! It's a competition, so
it's no
different from a race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll whoosh through and win with a bang!
Sit tight
and cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure our strategy is a success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Snow scatters into the air after each
footstep as
Haru Urara charges into the
enemy's territory with
several snowballs
in hand. When she returns...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: We won, we won, we won!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! Our strategy was a great success!

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Urara, congratulations! You really know
how to
make a match exciting. Here's
your prize!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh wow! It's a snow globe! Look at the
snowmen
and snow rabbits! They're so
cute! Yours matches
mine!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, me too! That way, even if it's spring,
summer,
or fall...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I can be reminded of the great fun I had
today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Haru Urara in the picture, today's
minor
snowball fight felt more like a
large-scale field
day. Not even snow can
slow her down.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Who knew they were hiding so
many
snowballs!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We made it to the semifinals only to fall
prey to
the hidden stock of snowballs
our opponents
prepared.

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Good job, Urara! I gotta say, you came
really
close there. Anyways, here's the
runner-up prize!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow, a bath towel with snowman
patterns?! Aww,
they're so smiley and
adorable!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! 'Cause I had so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I know! Let's have another snowball
fight
next year too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
When the time comes, let's think of
more
strategies than we did today! And
then, let's take
first place! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Against the chilly backdrop of snow,
Haru Urara
shows me her trademark
sunny smile.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Aww, nooo! We lost!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
They were amazing though! I tried
zipping past
them, but then those three
snowballs were like
pow, pow, pow!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
They must have had a number of
strategies up
their sleeves too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's win next time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I got some snowflake stickers
for
participating! I'll share them with you
later!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! This was so much fun, and we
even got
stickers! ...I'm so glad we
participated!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara hops and skips atop the snow
as if to
show everyone her joyous mood.
